name: Rahul Sharma
review: Sound quality is excellent and the noise cancellation works really well. Battery backup is also impressive. Worth the price.

name: Priya Patel
review: Very comfortable to wear for long hours. Delivery was quick and the product arrived in good condition. I expected a carry case in the box.

name: Amit Verma
review: I have been using these headphones daily for office work and music. Bluetooth connectivity is fast and the battery easily lasts for a couple of days.
